glyph_origin: Ideogrammic compound (會意): 亼 (“mouth”) + 皀 (“a bowl of rice on a stand”). In the modern form, the bowl of rice has corrupted into the similar but unrelated 良 or 艮. The variant form 𠊊 preserves the original composition. Shuowen interprets the 亼 as a phonetic component.
shuowen: Shuowen interprets the 亼 as a phonetic component.
senses: [shí] (literary, Cantonese, Hakka) to eat; to have a meal; to take in
(Coastal Min) to eat; to have a meal; to take in
[yì] Used in an ancient personal name.
